text:
From big banks to fashion brands, tenants are taking advantage of potential lower rents for retail space in Hong Kong’s prime areas as they utilise eye-catching locations to boost visibility towards customers, according to agents.
HSBC is unveiling its first flagship branch at the Capitol Centre, which was previously occupied by fashion retailers such as Cha
text_zh: 据中介机构称，从大型银行到时尚品牌，租户正利用香港核心区域潜在的较低租金，抢占引人注目的位置以提升对客户的曝光度。汇丰银行将在京华中心开设其首家旗舰分行，该位置此前曾由时尚零售商如Cha等占用。
